seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Harrison Township, Michigan for 2026: the library tree lighting on December 3, with date, time and address checked on the host's site.
lede: Harrison Township lights its tree at the public library with crafts, music and refreshments.
celebrates: Harrison Township Public Library hosts the township's annual tree lighting on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 6 to 8 pm at 38255 L'Anse Creuse Street. The 2026 theme is Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree, and the library promises crafting, music, refreshments and the grand lighting of the tree. The township's parks and recreation department keeps a Christmas Tree Lighting and visit with Santa page on its site, which links to photo galleries from the 2024 and 2025 events but has not posted a 2026 date.
lastyear: The township's parks and recreation page for its Christmas Tree Lighting and visit with Santa links to photo albums from the 2025 and 2024 tree lightings, showing the event is an annual tradition. For 2026, the library's own calendar lists the December 3 tree lighting with the Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree theme.
facts: The library's event listing is tagged Community Content, Family Friendly, Festival and Fair, and Holiday. The library's phone number on the listing is (586) 329-1261. The township's own parks and recreation page pairs its tree lighting with a visit with Santa, but it lists no 2026 date, so only the library event is built on this page.
trains: Harrison Township has no Christmas train listed this season. The Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens, in the same county, keeps its depot museum open on Sundays from 1 to 4 pm and says its train rides return in 2027. Clinton Township says its Holiday Express train ride is not available in 2026. The Santa Express runs at the Southern Michigan Railroad in Clinton, Michigan, on select weekends from November 28 to December 13, 2026, a long drive west.
